sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Turns off the location, Wi-Fi and network data SDKs.
Skips the splash screen's wait of up to 5 seconds.
Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+), with rounder corners and more spacing.
Unlocks premium (no ads, music equalizer) and keeps the ad networks from starting.
Shows the song title and album art in the media notification, instead of the station name.
